## Script Summary 
- Loads harmonized meta data RDS file

- Adds meta data to all SummarizedExperiment objects for the mutation omics layer


## Path Setting
Load in metadata RDS object and define directory with SummarizedExperiment objects
```{r data loading}
#Where the meta data RDS file is
metadata <- readRDS(file.path(TCGA,"metadata/data/harmonized_metadata.rds"))

#Path where the summarized experiment objects you are updating are located
se_directory <- file.path(TCGA,"mutation/raw_data/raw_SE/")

#Path to directory you want to output to
output_directory <- file.path(TCGA,"mutation/processed_data/all/") 
```

## Add Meta Data to all Summarized Experiment Objects in folder
Here we loop through all SummarizedExperiment RDS files and add the harmonzied meta data to the SummarizedObject (which is then saved). 

This assumes the data has only one of each "submitter_id", which should be the case given only primary tumors were downloaded.

```{r Add Meta Data to Folder of Summarized Experiments}
#Creates a list of all files ending in .rds in se_directory
file_list <- list.files(path = se_directory, pattern = "*.rds", full.names = TRUE)


# Loop through files
for (file in file_list) {
  
  cat("Updating metadata for ", file, "\n")
  
  # Read in the file
  data <- readRDS(file)
  
  # Determine which samples are in the current TCGA project + assay
  samples_to_keep <- intersect(colnames(data), rownames(metadata))
  
  # Only keep metadata for the current project
  project_specific_metadata <- metadata[rownames(metadata) %in% samples_to_keep,]
  
  # Ensure metadata is a DataFrame object (needed to add as colData)
  project_specific_metadata <- DataFrame(project_specific_metadata)
  
  # Ensures the order of samples match between Summarized Experiment and metadata
  data_sorted <- data[, match(rownames(project_specific_metadata), colnames(data))]
  
  # Create a new SummarizedExperiment object if the samples are identical
  if (identical(colnames(data_sorted), rownames(project_specific_metadata))) {
    # Extract all assays from the original data and maintain their names
    assays_list <- lapply(assayNames(data_sorted), function(assay_name) assay(data_sorted, assay_name))
    names(assays_list) <- assayNames(data_sorted)  # Preserving the original assay names
    
    # Recreate the SummarizedExperiment with the new metadata and all assays
    new_se <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = SimpleList(assays_list),
                                   colData = project_specific_metadata,
                                   rowData = rowData(data_sorted))
    
    # Prepare file output name in output directory with the same file name as original
    output <- paste0(output_directory, "/", basename(file))
    
    # Save the RDS file
    saveRDS(new_se, output)
    
  } else {
    # Add error message for mismatch
    stop("Mismatch between column names (sample names) and metadata samples")
  }
}
```
